description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Sitinamaluwa, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 330116
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property rights. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property title matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
